title: To Thee My Tender Grief Confide
description: You couldn't convince Jiawei to join the crew. Will things go more smoothly with Nantuck?

flow.stepDescription: Talk to the Mondstadt fisherman Nantuck

dialogs.text: Hey, young fisherman, I'm glad to see you. What's up, have you run into some trouble?
Come come, I am your experienced angling guide. You can let me know about any issues you're having.
It makes sense that Kujirai is still obsessed with finding the "Lunar Leviathan" as her wish is...
Alas, if she knew the truth about the "Lunar Leviathan" she would be devastated.
What truth?
To be truthful, after from returning from the voyage, I did not stop researching about the "Lunar Leviathan". I finally found a clue in an ancient book.
Based on those clues, I went back out on the field and found out some shocking revelations.
I published my findings in a book, I heard it's doing well recently.
Here, I just happen to have a book left by the editor. The truth about the "Lunar Leviathan" is inside.
Paimon wants to see too! Let Paimon get a look!
"Regarding How The Lunar Leviathan Is Actually A Giant Sea Turtle" ... What a long title... Huh?
A giant sea turtle? The "Lunar Leviathan" is a giant sea turtle?
That's right, the "Lunar Leviathan" is a giant sea turtle.
That night, what we saw was a giant sea turtle with long bioluminescent plants growing on its back.
It was a pregnant sea turtle that was looking for land to lay her eggs, which was how we found our way home.
So go back and tell Kujirai, you eventually have to face the facts.
But, maybe this can be explained...
Seeing your expression, you probably don't believe me huh? But my research has evidence to back it up.
In the ancient tales, the "Lunar Leviathan" is an ancient creature, back when many animals lived on land.
Their ancestors were active in the Dragonspine area and you can even find fossils of them today.
I found some last time in <color=#00E1FFFF>Wyrmrest Valley</color>. If you don't believe me you can go see for yourself.

flow.stepDescription: Go to Dragonspine to search for the Lunar Leviathan fossil

dialogs.text: All that's left is some Ore Slag. Seems like someone took something from here.
Eh?! Is that...a Treasure Hoarder?
Could it be them who removed the object from the rock scraps?
Quick! Follow them! Their encampment must be around here, whatever was hidden in the rock scraps must be there!
Let's go.
We have be to sneaky, very sneaky. We mustn't be caught.
Hey, you guys, do you think this shabby rock is worth anything? It's so rare that it's hidden in the ore.
Oh please, what do you mean by shabby rock, have you touched a book before in your life? It's called a fossil. A fossil, get it?
Not only is it worth a fortune, this alone can buy half of Liyue Harbor! Go back and read more!
Really? Is it worth that much? Then, with what we have in the camp, wouldn't we be really weather?
It's "wealthy!" You should go and read more too!
Hey! That guy over there, hand over the fossil!
Ah! Who is it? Darn...we've been spotted... Brothers, get them!

flow.stepDescription: Defeat the Treasure Hoarders and claim the fossil

dialogs.text: You guys are finally back, eh? Jiawei didn't come?
He stayed in the village.
Oh? He's become a family man? Haha! That seems like something he would do.
After all, that was his wish...alright, for this reason, he is forgiven.
What about Nantuck? Did you guys find him?
He wrote a Best-Selling book.
Never thought he'd actually be a writer, huh? Pretty talented, so what did he write about?
Paimon knows! Paimon knows! The books called "Regarding How The Lunar Leviathan Is Actually A Giant Sea Turtle".
Oh, that's a long name...is it a light novel? Not bad... I'll go buy a copy and read it too... Hmm? Wait a minute.
"Regarding How The Lunar Leviathan Is Actually..." It's actually a...?!
Mmhmm, it's actually a giant sea turtle.
What is this guy talking about? How could it be a giant sea turtle? Did he forget that we saw the "Lunar Leviathan" with our own eyes?
We didn't believe it at first...until we went to the snowy mountains and found the fossil of the "Lunar Leviathan"... Here you go, the book and the fossil.
No, I don't believe this. It's not true...
You don't understand, our family comes from a long lineage of fishermen, and my father is also a famous fisherman in Inazuma.
He had spent decades chasing the "Lunar Leviathan" on the ocean, and once, he almost succeeded.
Although it was all for naught, my father didn't give up. It would be a great honor for a fisherman if he could catch the legendary "Lunar Leviathan."
But after the next trip to sea...he never came back.
So, I won't believe such words easily, please help me out!
What do you plan to do then?
I'm going back to find the items my father left behind. He chased the "Lunar Leviathan" all his life and left a lot of information behind. I'm sure I can find a way.
I have prepared some fishing training for you, please wait for my good news, I will have to ask you for help then.
There's nothing here
These are just a bunch of rocks
There's nothing here
That looks like boar bones
There's nothing here
emmmm There's not even grass
